notes: The 'ye' of 'rejoice ye righteous' stands both after the imperative and before the vocative; it was given to the vocative on the strength of the ASV's own comma ('rejoice, ye righteous') and the parallel 'all ye that are upright' in the next colon (rule 36). Competing reading: 'ye' as the subject pronoun of גִילוּ under rule 17.
